overview: You wrote that you are in the Shrew this afternoon and that the part's name is not going on the leaf. The king's page stays upstairs, away from Kemp. The comedy's book stays with Garnish through tomorrow.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the refusal of the name.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Does not see the king's page.

assets.name: The Taming of the Shrew
assets.disposition: Did not put the part's name on the leaf

summary: Did not put the part's name on the leaf
